name: Velka Mate-Pomegranate Surge
description: A caffeinated carbonated blend from Rekova Labs combining synth-mate with pomegranate concentrate, positioned as a functional energy drink with antioxidant marketing claims. Aggressively sweetened to mask the synthetic mate bitterness.
flavor_profile: Sweet-tart pomegranate dominates the front palate; the mate bitterness emerges mid-drink and lingers; finish is slightly metallic, a known artifact of Rekova's carbonation process
cultural_context: Heavily marketed toward Tier 2 shift workers needing a second-wind caffeine hit; the slogan resonates with double-shift culture in the manufacturing belts; Rekova sponsors several underground athletics leagues which keeps brand loyalty high.
story_hooks: Rekova Labs is quietly reformulating Velka to include a mild mood-stabilizer compound — legal in trace amounts, but the dosage in the new batch isn't trace.

A Tier 2 workers' collective is organizing a boycott of Rekova products after a union leader was found to have been on the company's payroll; Velka cans are being used as protest symbols, spray-painted and left at corponation checkpoints.
Someone is selling counterfeit Velka cans filled with a very different substance — one that interacts catastrophically with standard BCI implants.
